name: projipsa
description: A project butler with separate skills for project memory, onboarding, compaction, and substantial delivery in Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build.

interface.shortDescription: A project butler for memory and delivery.
interface.longDescription: Projipsa is a project butler for Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build. Separate skills keep source-backed memory current, explicitly onboard existing projects, safely audit or compact accumulated artifacts, and qualify or manage substantial work from discovery through verified review and handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use $projipsa:projipsa to brief me from this project's maintained memory.
Use $projipsa:projipsa-init to onboard this existing project.
Use $projipsa:compact to audit this project's memory for safe compaction without deleting anything.
Use $projipsa:outsource to qualify this substantial project and manage it after I opt in.
